hook.text: Skip the waiting room. Sildenafil and tadalafil, prescription medicines for erectile dysfunction, online.

steps.text: Complete a secure health questionnaire. A licensed provider reviews it. If appropriate, a licensed pharmacy ships it.

price.text: Doctor visit and shipping included. Tadalafil starts at eighty-nine dollars a month, or under fifty on a three-month plan. Sildenafil is eighty-nine dollars a month, or forty-three on a three-month plan.

trust.text: Both are FDA-approved generics from a licensed pharmacy. Prescribing is never guaranteed. A provider decides.

isi.text: Important safety information. Do not take either medicine with nitrates, often used for chest pain, or riociguat. It can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. Seek help right away for an erection lasting over four hours, or sudden vision or hearing loss. Common side effects: headache, flushing, upset stomach. Tell your provider about your health and all medicines you take.

close.text: Beema Health. Prescription required. Learn more at beemahealth dot com.
